name: Overheat
description: Tracks the damage this unit deals to each enemy. Once one has accumulated %threshold% damage it overheats, dealing %damage% damage to every other enemy within %radius% tile.
details: An overheating unit never burns itself, only its neighbours.
Each enemy can overheat at most once per turn, and overheating always empties its counter - damage past the threshold is lost.
The overheat's own damage does not count toward anyone's gauge.

upgrade.summary: Overheating spreads Burn instead of dealing direct damage.
details: An overheating unit never burns itself, only its neighbours.
Each enemy can overheat at most once per turn, and overheating always empties its counter - damage past the threshold is lost.
Overheating applies %burn_stacks% stack of Burn to every other enemy within %radius% tile instead of dealing direct damage.
